description: This file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot REST API, capturing various exceptions and translating them into structured HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice class that handles exceptions globally, providing custom HTTP responses for various error conditions.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, returning 400 Bad Request with detailed field errors.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolation
methods.description: Handles database integrity violations, returning 409 Conflict with specific error code.

methods.name: handleSqlGrammar
methods.description: Handles SQL syntax errors, returning 500 Internal Server Error with optional SQLState details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions, returning 500 Internal Server Error.
